conversation.message: By "augment human capabilities," I mean AI tools that enhance our existing skills and knowledge, allowing us to achieve more efficiently and effectively. This could involve AI handling repetitive tasks, providing advanced analysis, or offering new insights we might miss.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
